description: This file contains the implementation of the FinancialActivityAccountReadPlatformService, including methods for retrieving all financial activity accounts, retrieving a specific account by ID, and preparing template data for new accounts. It interacts with the database via JdbcTemplate, and maps database rows to data objects.

classes.name: FinancialActivityAccountReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the service interface to read financial activity accounts, includes methods to fetch all accounts, a specific account, and to prepare account templates.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of all financial activity accounts from the database.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Fetches a specific financial activity account by its ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: addTemplateDetails
methods.description: Adds dropdown options and financial activity options to a FinancialActivityAccountData object for template purposes.

methods.name: getFinancialActivityAccountTemplate
methods.description: Creates and returns a new FinancialActivityAccountData object populated with template options.

classes.name: FinancialActivityAccountMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to convert database rows into FinancialActivityAccountData objects.
